Third-party notices — Sphinx for Android, VPN (TUNNEL) mode
============================================================

Sphinx itself is released under the MIT License (see the
repository LICENSE). VPN mode BUNDLES the components below
inside the app. Bundling them does not change Sphinx's
license; each component keeps its own license, reproduced in
this folder, and this notices file travels with the app as
those licenses require.

--------------------------------------------------------
Version pinned: 1.0.20250531 (exact version, Maven Central).
License: Apache License, Version 2.0.
License text: LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt in this folder.
Verified before integration (2026-10-23) from primary
sources: the artifact's Maven POM declares "The Apache
Software License, Version 2.0", and the wireguard-android
repository's COPYING file is the Apache-2.0 text.
Copyright (c) 2017-2025 WireGuard LLC. WireGuard is a
registered trademark of Jason A. Donenfeld.

--------------------------------------------------------
License: MIT License.
License text: LICENSE-WIREGUARD-GO-MIT.txt in this folder.

----------------------------------------------------------

Copyright (c) ZXing authors.

What is NOT bundled
-------------------
No OpenVPN code is bundled or linked. The embeddable
OpenVPN options for Android are GPLv3 / AGPLv3; linking
either would end this app's honest MIT story, so OpenVPN
profiles are stored and labeled, and connecting one is
refused with the reason named (docs/TUNNEL-SPEC.md).
